title: Drummers he played with and his own quartet with Garner, West and Collins
summary: He played with Jo Jones and Sid Catlett, and led his own quartet with Erroll Garner, drummer Harold West and John Collins while Tatum was away.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: How did you -- did you -- who were some of the drummers that you liked to play with during those years?
Well, I played a couple of times with Jo Jones and another one. I forget his name offhand.
Big Sid Catlett, yes, and another fellow who looks something like Jo . Forget his name. It'll come to me.

No, small like Jo . I made recordings with him. Well, anyway it'll come to me. There are quite a few (inaudible) one of my own drummers who was in my quartet, Harold West, and that's when Harold was playing drums with me, and our very good friend, Erroll Garner.
Who else was it? It was you, Garner, West --
That must have been a pretty hot band.
Did you all -- did you all work a lot?
We worked quite a bit. And that's when Tatum wasn't feeling too well, and he had to go home. That's when we were playing the Three Deuces.
